manifest.name: @caveman-ai/cli
manifest.description: Caveman CLI — wrap coding agents with recoverable local context compression and truthful metering (`caveman claude`), then drive Caveman Cloud from terminal. Compression and metering run in companion Go binaries: run `caveman setup` to see install state. Local savings stay inferred until verified.

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-binaries.mjs && node scripts/gen-wedge-installer.mjs && node scripts/gen-device-auth.mjs && node scripts/compile-registries.mjs && tsc && node scripts/bundle-delegate.mjs && node scripts/bundle-tui.mjs && node scripts/bundle-pi-extension.mjs && node scripts/shebang.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/gen-binaries.mjs && node scripts/gen-wedge-installer.mjs && node scripts/gen-device-auth.mjs && node scripts/compile-registries.mjs && tsc && node scripts/bundle-delegate.mjs && node scripts/bundle-tui.mjs && node scripts/bundle-pi-extension.mjs && node scripts/shebang.mjs && node --import ./tests/fixtures/sanitize-host-env.mjs --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=4 tests/*.runtime.mjs
scripts.test:fast: node scripts/gen-binaries.mjs && node scripts/gen-wedge-installer.mjs && node scripts/gen-device-auth.mjs && node scripts/compile-registries.mjs && tsc && node scripts/bundle-delegate.mjs && node scripts/bundle-tui.mjs && node scripts/bundle-pi-extension.mjs && node --import ./tests/fixtures/sanitize-host-env.mjs --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=4 --test-reporter=dot tests/agent-native.runtime.mjs tests/agent-traffic.runtime.mjs tests/billing.runtime.mjs tests/capability-config.runtime.mjs tests/config-home.runtime.mjs tests/login-device-flow.runtime.mjs tests/login.runtime.mjs tests/mcp-surface.runtime.mjs tests/modules-apply.runtime.mjs tests/modules-index.runtime.mjs tests/modules-status.runtime.mjs tests/onboard-agent-door.runtime.mjs tests/onboard-interactive.runtime.mjs tests/onboard-setup.runtime.mjs tests/porcelain.runtime.mjs tests/practice-registry.runtime.mjs tests/routing.runtime.mjs tests/skills.runtime.mjs tests/status.runtime.mjs tests/subscription-recovery.runtime.mjs tests/wrap-gate.runtime.mjs
